## Summary

I have successfully implemented the mind-map branch status feature (work order 1). Here's what was completed:

### Files Changed

**A. Migration (1 file)**
- `alembic/versions/0044_2026_10_15_mindmap_branch_status.py` — Adds per-branch status columns to `memory_map_membership`: `status` (open/resolved/dropped), `resolution_summary`, `resolved_by_memory_id`, `resolved_by_party`, `resolved_at`. Also adds an index on `memory_map_events(root_memory_id, id)` for efficient cursor reads.

**B. Service Layer (1 file modified)**
- `src/mem_mcp/mindmap/service.py` — Added 8 new functions:
  - `lock_map_row()` — locks map for update
  - `get_membership_for_update()` — locks membership row
  - `memory_visible_in_tenant()` — checks memory visibility
  - `set_branch_status()` — updates branch status atomically
  - `current_cursor()` — returns max event id
  - `touched_member_ids_since()` — finds nodes touched since a cursor
  - Updated `log_event()` to return the event id
  - Updated `fetch_members()` to include status columns
  - Added constants: `BRANCH_STATUSES`, `RESOLUTION_REFERENCE_KINDS`

**C. New Tool (1 file)**
- `src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_resolve.py` — New `mindmap_resolve` tool to settle branches with atomic status + edge + event updates. Validates input, checks permissions, creates optional resolves-under/dropped-under edges.

**D. Tool Updates (2 files)**
- `src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_get.py` — Enhanced with:
  - New input fields: `since` (cursor-based filtering), `include` (open/all), `depth` (summary/full)
  - New output fields: `cursor`, `resolved` list
  - Content truncation at 200 chars in summary mode
  - Separate open and resolved nodes based on `include` parameter
  - Cheap reads via `since` cursor
- `src/mem_mcp/main.py` — Registered `MindmapResolveTool`

**E. Tool Descriptions (1 file)**
- `src/mem_mcp/mcp/tool_descriptions.py` — Added `mindmap_resolve` description and updated `mindmap_get` to document new parameters.

**F. Documentation (2 files)**
- `docs/mindmap-v1-build-design.md` — Updated memory_map_membership table schema and tool table to include mindmap_resolve
- `skills/mindmap-driver/SKILL.md` — Added "Settle a branch" section and "Resume cheaply" section

**G. Tests (2 files)**
- `tests/unit/test_mindmap_get_shaping.py` — 10 unit tests covering:
  - Input defaults and validation
  - Content truncation at exactly 200 chars boundary
  - Full vs summary depth behavior
- `tests/integration/test_mindmap_resolve_e2e.py` — 10 integration tests covering:
  - Resolve without/with resolver nodes
  - Dropped disposition (dropped-under edges)
  - Error cases (unknown map, node not in map, root node, empty summary)
  - mindmap_get integration (status on nodes, resolved list, open_loops exclusion)
  - Cursor-based resume

### Verification

**Migration:**
```bash
alembic upgrade head    # ✅ Successfully applied
alembic downgrade -1 && alembic upgrade head    # ✅ Round-trip successful
```

**Tests (36 total):**
```bash
pytest -q tests/unit/test_mindmap_get_shaping.py tests/integration/test_mindmap_resolve_e2e.py \
       tests/integration/test_mindmap_e2e.py tests/unit/test_lint_tenant_scope.py
# ✅ 36 passed in 1.42s
```

**Linting & Type Checking:**
```bash
ruff check src/mem_mcp/mindmap/service.py src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_*.py src/mem_mcp/main.py
# ✅ All checks passed

ruff format --check ...    # ✅ All formatted correctly

mypy src/mem_mcp/mindmap/service.py src/mem_mcp/mcp/tools/mindmap_*.py
# ✅ Success: no issues found
```

**Key Features Implemented:**
- ✅ Per-branch status tracking (open/resolved/dropped)
- ✅ Atomic resolution with optional resolver edge
- ✅ Reference kinds: `resolves-under`, `dropped-under`
- ✅ Cheap cursor-based reads with `since` parameter
- ✅ Content truncation in summary mode (200 chars)
- ✅ Open loops exclude resolved branches
- ✅ Defense-in-depth: explicit tenant filtering on all queries
- ✅ Comprehensive error handling with opaque cross-team semantics
